headers.name: base
headers.doc: The base of the Maul RHI API: the library and contract versions, the export and attribute macros, the result codes every fallible function returns, the allocator and the extension chain.

items.name: result
items.doc: The status a fallible function returns. Zero is success, positive values are outcomes that are not errors, negative values are errors. The type has a fixed width so that result structs have one layout in C and C++.

values.name: success
values.doc: The call did what was asked.

values.name: empty
values.doc: There is nothing to return: the notification queue is drained.

values.name: error_invalid
values.doc: An argument is invalid: a null pointer where one is required, a value out of range, a def without its cookie.

values.name: error_capacity
values.doc: A caller buffer, a named limit or the allocator is too small for the result.

values.name: error_stale
values.doc: An id names an object that no longer exists.

values.name: error_unsupported
values.doc: This platform, driver or build cannot do what was asked, or a def carries a critical extension the library does not know.

values.name: error_platform
values.doc: The platform or its GPU driver failed a call the library made.

values.name: error_state
values.doc: The call is not allowed now, in the object's current state.

values.name: error_version
values.doc: The program was built against another contract version.

items.name: version
items.doc: A library version: major, minor and patch.

items.name: allocator
items.doc: The allocator an owner object takes in its def and keeps for its lifetime. Alignment is a power of two. A zeroed allocator means the C library's functions, which serve alignments up to that of max_align_t.

items.name: struct_type
items.doc: The type of a chained struct. Bit 31 clear marks a critical extension, which a library that does not know it refuses; bit 31 set marks a hint it may skip.

values.name: struct_none
values.doc: No struct: never valid in a chain.

values.name: struct_test_driver
values.doc: mrhiTestDriverDef, on an instance def: turns the test driver on.

items.name: chain
items.doc: The header every chained struct opens with. A def's next field, or a chained struct's chain.next, points at the next struct of the chain, or is NULL.

items.name: request_id
items.doc: A request, answered by exactly one notification in its owner's queue.

items.name: get_version
items.doc: Returns the version of the library that was linked, which may differ from the MRHI_VERSION macros a program was compiled with.

items.name: result_name
items.doc: Returns the name of a result code, for diagnostics.

returns.doc: A static, NUL-terminated string such as "mrhi_errorCapacity".

args.name: result
args.doc: Any value; an unknown one is named as such.

headers.name: instance
headers.doc: The instance: the root of Maul RHI, made first and destroyed last, which negotiates the contract version and finds the adapters.

items.name: instance
items.doc: An instance, made by mrhiCreateInstance.

items.name: adapter_name_bytes
items.doc: The bytes an adapter's name may take, in UTF-8.

items.name: adapter_id
items.doc: An adapter: a GPU, or a software rasterizer, that a driver found.

items.name: driver_kind
items.doc: The GPU API a driver speaks.

values.name: driver_test
values.doc: The test driver: no GPU, for tests.

values.name: driver_vulkan
values.doc: Vulkan.

values.name: driver_web_gpu
values.doc: The browser's WebGPU.

values.name: driver_metal
values.doc: Metal.

values.name: driver_d3d12
values.doc: Direct3D 12.

items.name: adapter_kind
items.doc: What kind of processor an adapter is.

values.name: adapter_unknown
values.doc: The driver does not say.

values.name: adapter_discrete
values.doc: A GPU with its own memory.

values.name: adapter_integrated
values.doc: A GPU sharing the CPU's memory.

values.name: adapter_virtual
values.doc: A GPU of a virtual machine.

values.name: adapter_software
values.doc: A rasterizer running on the CPU.

items.name: power_preference
items.doc: Which adapters a request prefers.

values.name: power_default
values.doc: The driver's own order.

values.name: power_low
values.doc: Integrated and low-power adapters first.

values.name: power_high
values.doc: Discrete and fast adapters first.

items.name: adapter_info
items.doc: What an adapter is.

members.name: vendor_id
members.doc: The PCI vendor id, or 0 where the platform hides it.

members.name: device_id
members.doc: The PCI device id, or 0 where the platform hides it.

members.name: name
members.doc: The adapter's name in UTF-8, nameLength bytes, not NUL-terminated.

items.name: adapter_request_def
items.doc: Which adapters a request looks for. Build it with mrhiDefaultAdapterRequestDef.

members.name: allow_software
members.doc: Whether software rasterizers may answer.

items.name: instance_notification_kind
items.doc: What an instance notification reports.

values.name: instance_adapters_found
values.doc: An adapter request is answered: its outcome is mrhi_success, and mrhiGetAdapters lists the adapters, or an error.

items.name: instance_notification
items.doc: A record from an instance's notification queue.

members.name: request_id
members.doc: The request the record answers.

members.name: outcome
members.doc: How the request ended.

items.name: instance_limits
items.doc: The named limits of an instance.

members.name: chain_depth
members.doc: Chained structs one def may carry; 8 by default.

members.name: notifications
members.doc: Records the notification queue holds; 64 by default.

members.name: adapters
members.doc: Adapters the instance keeps; 16 by default.

items.name: instance_def
items.doc: How an instance is made. Build it with mrhiDefaultInstanceDef.

members.name: contract_version
members.doc: MRHI_CONTRACT_VERSION, as the program was built.

items.name: default_instance_def
items.doc: Returns the default instance def: the contract version the program is built against, the C library's allocator and the default limits (8 chained structs per def, 64 notifications, 16 adapters).

returns.doc: The def, with a valid cookie.

items.name: create_instance
items.doc: Makes an instance.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument, a def without its cookie, a zero limit or an allocator with one function; `mrhi_errorVersion` when the def's contract version is not the library's; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` for a critical extension the library does not know, such as mrhiTestDriverDef in a build without the test driver; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the chain is deeper than the limit or the allocator fails.

args.name: instance_out
args.doc: Receives the instance; set to NULL on failure.

items.name: destroy_instance
items.doc: Destroys an instance. Its devices must be destroyed first.

args.name: instance
args.doc: The instance, or NULL for nothing.

items.name: get_instance_misuse
items.doc: Returns how many calls the instance has refused as invalid input (mrhi_errorInvalid): a count release builds can watch to catch a caller's bugs. Stale ids are not misuse.

returns.doc: The count; 0 for a NULL instance.

items.name: default_adapter_request_def
items.doc: Returns the default adapter request def: the driver's own order, software rasterizers allowed.

returns.doc: The def, with a valid cookie.

items.name: request_adapters
items.doc: Asks the instance's drivers for adapters. The request is answered by one mrhi_instanceAdaptersFound record; until then, mrhiGetAdapters lists the adapters found before.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success` with the request accepted; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument or a def without its cookie; `mrhi_errorUnsupported` for a critical extension the library does not know; `mrhi_errorCapacity` when the notification queue has no room for the answer.

items.name: next_instance_notification
items.doc: Takes the oldest record from the instance's notification queue, first polling its drivers for finished work.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success` with a record; `mrhi_empty` when the queue is drained; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument.

items.name: get_adapters
items.doc: Lists the adapters the last answered request found, best first by its preference.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL instance or count, or a NULL array with a capacity.

args.name: adapters
args.doc: Receives up to capacity ids. May be NULL when capacity is 0.

args.name: count_out
args.doc: Receives the number of adapters, which may exceed capacity.

items.name: get_adapter_info
items.doc: Reads what an adapter is.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument; `mrhi_errorStale` for an adapter the instance no longer has.

headers.name: capabilities
headers.doc: What an adapter can do: the optional features and the limits, each mapped onto the four APIs in docs/contract/mappings.md.

items.name: features
items.doc: The optional features (record R18). The floor (compute, indirect draws, instancing, the texture kinds, independent blend, occlusion queries) needs no request.

members.name: timestamp_query
members.doc: Timestamps at pass boundaries (record R20).

vulkan.note: timestampComputeAndGraphics and the queue's valid bits

members.name: pipeline_statistics_query
members.doc: Pipeline statistics queries.

metal.note: a statistic counter set on some Macs, none on Apple GPUs

members.name: texture_compression_bc
members.doc: BC1 to BC7 textures.

members.name: texture_compression_etc2
members.doc: ETC2 and EAC textures.

members.name: texture_compression_astc
members.doc: ASTC LDR textures.

members.name: float32_filterable
members.doc: Filtering of 32-bit float textures.

vulkan.note: format features of the 32-bit float formats

members.name: rg11b10_renderable
members.doc: Rendering to rg11b10ufloat.

members.name: dual_source_blending
members.doc: Blending with a second fragment output.

members.name: unclipped_depth
members.doc: Depth clamped instead of clipped, for shadow pancaking.

members.name: shader_f16
members.doc: 16-bit floats in shaders.

members.name: subgroups
members.doc: Subgroup operations.

members.name: shader_int64
members.doc: 64-bit integers in shaders.

members.name: indirect_first_instance
members.doc: A first instance other than zero in indirect draws.

members.name: multi_draw_indirect_count
members.doc: Multi-draw indirect with a GPU-written count.

metal.note: an indirect command buffer filled by a compute pass

members.name: multiview
members.doc: Rendering several views in one pass.

members.name: bindless_sampling
members.doc: A heap of sampled textures and samplers (record R1).

web_gpu.note: until the resource table draft ships (sampling-resource-table)

members.name: bindless_heterogeneous
members.doc: A heap of every resource kind but uniform buffers (record R1).

vulkan.note: descriptor heaps, or descriptor indexing over the storage types

members.name: present_timing
members.doc: Presentation timestamps and a target present time.

items.name: limits
items.doc: The limits (record R19): WebGPU's floor in the contract's terms. An adapter reports its values; a device def requests values, the defaults being the floor.

members.name: texture_dimension_2d
members.doc: The width and height of a 2D or cube texture.

members.name: texture_dimension_3d
members.doc: Each dimension of a 3D texture.

members.name: texture_array_layers
members.doc: The layers of an array texture.

members.name: binding_tables
members.doc: Binding tables a pipeline declares (record R1).

vulkan.note: descriptor sets, or heap indices in the root block

members.name: bindings_per_table
members.doc: Slots in one binding table.

members.name: sampled_textures_per_stage
members.doc: Sampled textures one shader stage binds.

members.name: samplers_per_stage
members.doc: Samplers one shader stage binds.

members.name: storage_buffers_per_stage
members.doc: Storage buffers one shader stage binds.

members.name: storage_textures_per_stage
members.doc: Storage textures one shader stage binds.

members.name: uniform_buffers_per_stage
members.doc: Uniform buffers one shader stage binds.

members.name: uniform_binding_bytes
members.doc: The bytes of one uniform buffer binding.

members.name: storage_binding_bytes
members.doc: The bytes of one storage buffer binding.

members.name: uniform_offset_alignment
members.doc: The alignment of a uniform binding's offset; lower is better.

members.name: storage_offset_alignment
members.doc: The alignment of a storage binding's offset; lower is better.

members.name: vertex_buffers
members.doc: Vertex buffers a pipeline reads.

metal.note: 31 buffer slots, shared with argument tables

members.name: tables_plus_vertex_buffers
members.doc: Binding tables and vertex buffers together.

members.name: buffer_bytes
members.doc: The bytes of one buffer.

members.name: vertex_attributes
members.doc: Vertex attributes a pipeline reads.

members.name: vertex_stride
members.doc: The stride of one vertex buffer.

members.name: inter_stage_variables
members.doc: Four-component variables passed between shader stages.

members.name: color_attachments
members.doc: Color targets of one render pass.

members.name: color_bytes_per_sample
members.doc: The bytes of all color targets in one sample.

members.name: workgroup_storage_bytes
members.doc: The workgroup memory of one compute pipeline.

members.name: workgroup_invocations
members.doc: The invocations of one workgroup.

members.name: workgroup_size_x
members.doc: A workgroup's size in x.

members.name: workgroup_size_y
members.doc: A workgroup's size in y.

members.name: workgroup_size_z
members.doc: A workgroup's size in z.

members.name: workgroups_per_dimension
members.doc: Workgroups one dispatch has in each dimension.

members.name: root_block_bytes
members.doc: The bytes of the root block each draw or dispatch sets (record R1).

web_gpu.note: a dynamic-offset uniform buffer where immediates are missing, maxImmediateSize where present

members.name: heap_size
members.doc: Entries of the resource heap; 0 without a bindless feature, at most 65536 portably.

vulkan.note: descriptor indexing counts or the heap's size

members.name: sampler_heap_size
members.doc: Entries of the sampler heap; 0 without a bindless feature.

members.name: frames_in_flight
members.doc: Frames recorded while earlier ones still run on the GPU.

items.name: default_limits
items.doc: Returns the floor limits, which every adapter of every driver meets: WebGPU's defaults, 64 root block bytes, no heaps and 2 frames in flight.

items.name: get_adapter_features
items.doc: Reads the optional features an adapter can grant.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument; `mrhi_errorStale` for an adapter the instance no longer has.

items.name: get_adapter_limits
items.doc: Reads the limits an adapter can grant, each at least the floor.

returns.doc: `mrhi_success`; `mrhi_errorInvalid` for a NULL argument; `mrhi_errorStale` for an adapter the instance no longer has.

headers.name: test
headers.doc: The test driver (MAUL_RHI_TEST_DRIVER): a driver without a GPU whose adapters a test describes, for the library's tests and a program's own.

items.name: test_adapter
items.doc: An adapter the test driver finds: its facts, features and limits.

items.name: test_driver_def
items.doc: Turns the test driver on for an instance, chained on its def with the type mrhi_structTestDriver. The test driver is the only driver of such an instance.

members.name: adapters
members.doc: The adapters the driver finds, in its own order. May be NULL when adapterCount is 0.
